svg.title: TX card cage side and front
svg.text: SIDE (section): back wall and pole left, lid right
glands in the bottom wall (2 x 4): 6 PG-7, 2 PG-9 (right column)
base / lid seam (Yb 97): lid tray beyond
TX stack r3 in the printed PETG base (100 deep) under the #905 lid, hanging long side up, to scale 3.2 px/mm; inside 124 x 169 x 120 mm (lid interface: L1 and the coupon fit [TBD-MEASURE])
Blue: moulded cage features. Red slabs: cards. Tan: backplane. Dashed: plug keep-outs. Grey: corner posts, gland nuts, pole lugs and drip edge.
Shelves bottom to top: the pack, the BQ25798EVM (90 x 90, J8 toward the lid), B4, B2, B1, B3; all slide toward the back. Glands in the bottom wall; cables rise in the right column.
